data.name: Rajaaun
data.gender_notes: Rajaaun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rajaaun is derived from the Arabic root r-j-a, which means 'to return'. This name is often given to a child who is born after the loss of a sibling or parent, as a symbol of hope and the return of joy to the family. The name Rajaaun carries the meaning “Return, Redemption” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rajaaun usually hope their child will grow to embody return, redemption and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rajaaun is a name that carries deep spiritual significance in Islam. It is believed that Allah grants redemption and forgiveness to those who seek Him with sincere repentance and a pure heart.
data.etymology: Rajaaun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Return, Redemption.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rajaaun total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: رَجاءً
in_arabic.long_meaning: رَجاءً هو اسم مشتق من الفعل رجاء، ويعني الأمل والتمني في الله تعالى. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى الأمل في رحمة الله وفرجه. ورد ذكر الفعل رجاء في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَيَرْجُونَ رَحْمَتَهُ' (الإسراء: 57)، مما يبرز الأهمية الدينية لهذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: رجاﺅن
in_urdu.long_meaning: رجاﺅن ایک نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے فعل 'رجاء' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے امید اور توقع۔ اردو میں، یہ نام اللہ تعالیٰ کی رحمت اور بخشش کی امید کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ عربی جڑوں سے اخذ کردہ، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان اور ہندوستان میں جہاں اردو ایک وسیع زبان ہے۔

in_english.name: Rajaaun
in_english.long_meaning: Rajaaun is a name derived from the Arabic verb 'رجاء' (rajā'), meaning hope and expectation. Etymologically linked to Quranic references, such as 'وَيَرْجُونَ رَحْمَتَهُ' (al-Isrā': 57), this name signifies reliance on Allah's mercy and forgiveness. Historically and spiritually, it embodies the Islamic value of maintaining hope and trust in divine providence. The name is used across Muslim cultures to inspire optimism and faith.
